candidates.snippet:
Marjorie Taylor Greene on Trump:

Trump absolutely should apologize to me. He should apologize to many people. He should apologize to the woman in the press that he called Piggy. He should apologize to countless people. 

He should apologize to America for betraying his campaign

Senator Ted Cruz on Iran:

It’s not our business to determine who the government of Iran is, but it is our business to say, the government of Iran should not be a radical theocrat who hates America and is trying to kill Americans. 

Trump is acting as a strong commander in chief

Senator Ted Cruz on Iran:

What I’ve been urging is for Trump and the Trump administration to arm the protesters, so the people of Iran, arm the Kurds and let the protesters remove this regime from power. 

Not American boots on the ground, but the Iranian people. https://t.co/1v
